ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface covering approximately 85-90% of the visible fluke, contrasted with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized at the tips and in scattered circular nodes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A large contiguous low-intensity dark region across the main body of both lobes; a high-contrast white cluster at the left distal tip; numerous discrete, small high-intensity circular nodes (white rings/dots) distributed across the upper half of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A shallow V-shaped depression; the vertex and specific pixel angle are partially obscured by high-intensity water spray/splash.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing boundary characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) across the entire visible horizontal span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve extending from the central notch region outward toward the tapered distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense detection of localized circular white-on-black high-contrast rings across the upper half of both lobes, consistent with barnacle attachment site geometry.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of faint, unaligned light-grey linear pixel disruptions (scratches) on the right lobe and center-left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring across the dark pigmentation; visible irregular nicks and jagged disruptions along the trailing edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced high-intensity white pigmentation patch isolated at the extreme outer tip of the left lobe.
